phrase_identite: Lydia Schierig works as Junior Field Marketing Manager DACH in B2B at Powell in Paris. She has been pursuing the MBA Marketing Digital et Intelligence Artificielle (MDIA) at De Vinci Executive Education since March 2026.

employeur.description: French provider of digital workplace solutions, founded in 2014 and based in Paris.

ce_que_je_fais:
Lydia Schierig works on developing Powell's presence in the DACH market. She adapts existing marketing content for German-speaking audiences, creates German-language campaigns and selects suitable content for each channel.
She uses artificial intelligence in this work, particularly to translate and adapt content.
parcours: Lydia Schierig studied Languages and Business Administration at Westsächsische Hochschule Zwickau from 2014 to 2020, specialising in the Francophone cultural region with a focus on marketing, and earned a Bachelor of Arts. During her studies, she spent two semesters in France, including an Erasmus exchange at IUT de Vannes in 2016, and completed a 12-month internship in Paris (2018 to 2019). From 2020 to 2022, she lived and worked in Berlin in digital marketing and B2B sales, including at a marketing agency. She then worked as Marketing Manager DACH at a software provider from 2022 to 2024. She moved to Paris in January 2023. Since 2024, she has been studying web development independently. In March 2026, she began working as Junior Field Marketer DACH at Powell under a French work-study arrangement (alternance) and started the MBA Marketing Digital et Intelligence Artificielle (MDIA) at De Vinci Executive Education.

entite_liee.nom: Les défis de l'expansion interculturelle d'une solution de Digital Workplace française sur le marché DACH : quelles stratégies de go-to-market pour réussir son implantation germanophone ?
entite_liee.description: Professional thesis currently in progress, written in French as part of the MBA Marketing Digital et Intelligence Artificielle (MDIA) at De Vinci Executive Education. English translation of the title: The challenges of cross-cultural expansion for a French digital workplace solution in the DACH market: What go-to-market strategies can support its successful establishment in German-speaking markets? A case study of Powell based on qualitative interviews with DACH market stakeholders and an analysis of reference cases.
